name: Delovna akcija
overview: It's time for good deeds and selfless help - it's time for the Work Campaign! The show will help families who cannot afford to do it themselves to renovate their homes. With the help of a team of professionals and top craftsmen, new hope will shine into their lives. With the new home, they will not only improve their living conditions, but will also present their stories, with the help of presenter Ana Praznik.
